title: Revisiting the Reliability of Psychological Scales on Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the consistency of the model's personality traits (Big Five Inventory scores) when the psychological scale's instructions and items are translated into 10 different languages.

Instructing the model to embody various heroic and villainous characters and comparing the resulting personality trait distributions to the model's default behavior, revealing an inherent positive skew.
